column8:
House of Tula 
Tula means balance in Sanskrit, I believe that we all need to live a more balanced life in these busy times as we are so over stimulated and our attention is so easily pulled externally so my little business was born from hoping to give people a space to be, to pause to breath and focus that attention inwards to create peace and stillness. Yoga is a very ancient beautiful practice that enables us to shine a light on our thoughts, our breath and our body to expose where we need to soften, listen, let go and just listen to what our body and mind need.

I feel that yoga is taught as a physical exercise a lot of the time which of course it is but it is an external practice to go internally,  to create space, peace stillness. 
An opportunity to stop and feel and be rather than to think and be. 
I think I teach yoga as a feeling rather than something you have to achieve, do or look a certain way in each posture asana and invite people to connect to their breath  and breath and see what comes up and what they need through the yoga, breathwork and guided meditation
